records.title: STATUS OF 12-C RAILWAY OVERBRIDGE PROJECTS IN KIRARI, DELHI
details:
19 Nos. Road Over Bridge (ROB)/Road Under Bridge (RUB) are sanctioned at
cost of ₹ 719 Cr in State of Delhi which are at various stages of planning and execution.
§
The construction of 4-lane ROB in lieu of LC No. 12 (Kirari crossing) has been included as part
of mega drain project of Delhi Government. An agreement has been reached as per which the work for
providing ROB at LC No 12 shall be executed by the state government.
Several site visits as well as other coordination meetings have been held between Railway,
MCD and PWD for early execution of project. Railway is extending all possible assistance for early
start of the project.

records.title: Nirbhaya Fund
details: The Scheme has been extended up to March, 2026 with a target of establishment of 790 FTSCs across the country. As per the information received from the High Courts, as of 31.10.2024, a total of 750 FTSCs including 408 exclusive POCSO Courts are functional in 30 States/UTs, which have disposed of more than 2,87,000 cases.

records.title: Structure collapse at airport terminals
details: This Ministry has constituted a High Level Expert Committee consisting of Structural Engineers from IIT Delhi to assess the incident at Delhi T1. Similarly, the Airports Authority of India has initiated investigations to determine the root cause of incidents at Jabalpur and Rajkot Airports.
